laura_ops: FYI APAC edge cluster dropped below safe capacity overnight — only 12 H200s available after yesterday's DOA returns. Need urgent top-up for APAC morning traffic :grimacing:

mohit_procure: how many do you need and by when?

laura_ops: 8 units ideally by Tue 09:00 SGT. If air isn't possible, need ETA and whether loaners are available.

anna_logistics: vendor said current outbound pool is on sea manifest — ETA 9 days. They offered refurbished loaners (30-day warranty) but require proforma + HS code confirmation for customs.

vendor_rep_skyline: Skyline here — can provide 8 loaner H200s on air if customer covers expedite surcharge. Need proforma (PO#) + HS code to clear into FRA/APAC transit. AWB can be split across two shipments.

ben_infra: loaners OK if firmware and NV driver parity is guaranteed. Any mismatches cause KV-cache issues in serving runtime. We need serial ranges and firmware versions before acceptance.

vendor_rep_skyline: understood. Furnishing a preflight pack: serials, fw versions, and per-unit `fw_hash` in the next 30m.

laura_ops: also need RMA labels for the DOAs. Last time customs blocked returns due to missing tariff docs. Please include `return_instructions.pdf` with HS classification.

anna_logistics: quick note — customs flagged similar GPUs under HS 8471.80 vs 8542 in APAC last quarter. Which classification are we using this time?

mohit_procure: Procurement prefers 8542 for lower duty, vendor is pushing 8471.80. We need vendor's legal justification.

vendor_rep_skyline: Skyline's legal confirms 8471.80 for compute modules; can share a short letter for customs. Will attach to proforma.

ben_infra: If loaners arrive, we need a swap window to avoid serving disruption. Plan: pre-stage with `kube cordon`, warm-up images, then swap overnight. Ops runbook ready.

laura_ops: good. Also flag: billing — vendor initial quote had a per-unit expedite fee + insurance. Can we get a consolidated invoice (one AWB) to minimize broker fees?

vendor_rep_skyline: We can consolidate but splitting was suggested to balance forwarder capacity. Consolidated invoice ok if you accept a single forwarder and pay the surcharge capped at $1,200.

anna_logistics: please send AWB(s) and invoice draft. I'll prefill customs broker form if we get HS letter and proforma.

mohit_procure: quick legal check — vendor loaner T&Cs: are there KMS/firmware locks preventing zero-touch integration? We need them unlocked or a signed waiver.

vendor_rep_skyline: loaners shipped with standard bootloader, no KMS lock. We'll provide `serial_manifest.csv` and `rma_agreement.pdf` for signatures.

laura_ops: perfect. One more — RMA flow for the DOAs. We need prepaid return labels for 6 DOA units, the rest are repairable in-region. Add SKUs and claim numbers to the labels.

vendor_rep_skyline: creating return labels now. Draft AWB for loaners: `SKY-TRK-APAC-55321` (air, ETA 36h) and returns AWB `SKY-RTN-14789` (economy). Will DM full docs.

ops_bot: Incident: apac-edge-01 degraded due to GPU count < 15. Auto-scaler paused. Ticket #INF-4729 created.

ben_infra: tagged the ticket, scheduling maintenance window Tue 02:00 SGT for swap.

laura_ops: thanks — Anna/Mohit/vendor, please get proforma + HS letter in next 2 hours so customs broker can prep. If air is confirmed, tell me total expedite cost so finance can approve. :pray:

vendor_rep_skyline: on it. ETA docs 45m. Will itemize: loaner fee $0 (courtesy), expedite surcharge $980, consolidated broker fee estimate $220, insurance adder $150.

mohit_procure: OK to approve expedite up to $1,200. Please DM final invoice and PO reference.

anna_logistics: I'll standby to submit broker intake once we have HS letter + proforma.

laura_ops: rolling with that plan. If vendor can't do air, fall back to prioritized sea manifest and we'll stagger routing to keep cluster healthy. :thumbsup:

vendor_rep_skyline: copy. Uploading docs now.

laura_ops: cheers — ping when AWB is booked so we can prep the swap runbook and badge pickups.
